title: Real Baum–Connes Isomorphism Conjecture
exact_target: For every countable discrete group $G$, is the real Baum–Connes assembly map $\operatorname{KO}_*^G(\underline EG)\to \operatorname{KO}_*(C_r^*(G;\mathbb R))$ an isomorphism?
